changelog:
Initial release: Enables inspection and monitoring of Alibaba Cloud API gateways.

- Inspect Cloud-Native API Gateway, AI Gateway, or API Gateway instances for health and performance.
- Query Cloud Monitor metrics such as CPU, memory, connections, network, and rate limiting.
- Requires user confirmation of all key parameters (product type, region, instance ID, time range) before queries.
- Enforces RAM read-only permissions and guides users through permission troubleshooting if needed.
- Commands are executed via the aliyun CLI plugin, using a unique session ID in the user agent for observability.
- Credentials and authentication handled securely through existing aliyun CLI configuration.
